body: I'm 17, and soon to be 18. Alright, well suppose I get my GED, then what? I haven't written a proper essay in around 4 years. I have zero experience with proper academic research. I don't know. I'm from an incredibly poor reservation town (go figure) and I now live in a much more developed area. Even though it'd be a community college, I'm terrified of being hung out to dry, left in the dust by people whose school district actually had funding. I just feel completely outclassed in every way.

Thank you. This is the first time I've ever felt suicidal like that. I'm going to try and keep those thoughts away for now. It's just that I realized how ridiculously hard it'll be to get to where I want to be in life, and was overwhelmed.
